news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.5% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Whole Time Director recently sold ₹9.8m worth of stock
news.body: On the 10th of December, Jasman Chadha sold around 8m shares on-market at roughly ₹1.18 per share. This transaction amounted to 100% of their direct individual holding at the time of the trade. This was the largest sale by an insider in the last 3 months. This was the only on-market transaction from insiders over the last 12 months.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.01 (vs ₹0.01 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.01 (in line with 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹33.1m (down 19% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹10.9m (down 1.0% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 33% (up from 27% in 2Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 136% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 65% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
